# Rice: Species and Panel Guidance

## Biology That Changes Simulation

Cultivated rice is diploid and largely self-pollinating. Diversity panels can
contain deep subpopulation structure, including indica, japonica, aus,
aromatic, and admixed accessions. A simulated diversity study should model or
remove this structure intentionally, never accidentally.

## 3K Rice Genomes Resource

The 3,000 Rice Genomes Project is an empirical diversity resource, not a
single homogeneous mapping population. When using a local subset, record the
sample manifest, subgroup labels, reference build, chromosome selection,
filtering thresholds, and imputation/phasing method.

## Simulation Decisions

- For a diversity GWAS, simulate phenotype effects, environment, and batch
  independently from subgroup labels unless the benchmark intentionally tests
  ancestry confounding.
- For breeding populations, choose founders from known subgroups and retain
  pedigree, ancestry tracts, and selfing generations.
- For genomic selection, use family- or subgroup-aware validation to avoid
  overstating accuracy through close relatives in both folds.

## Key Source

- 3,000 Rice Genomes Project (2014): DOI 10.1186/2047-217X-3-8.
